message.jaymoskingdoms.camp.group_formed: A ring of %s camps has formed around %s, preparing to siege!
message.jaymoskingdoms.camp.muster_begin: The camps around %s sound their horns: the muster for siege begins!
message.jaymoskingdoms.camp.muster_end: The muster is complete. The siege of %s begins!
message.jaymoskingdoms.camp.supplies_dra: The siege of %s draws supplies from nearby camps.
message.jaymoskingdoms.camp.cleared_weak: The camp %s has fallen! The siege of %s is weakened.
message.jaymoskingdoms.siege.victory: The siege of %s is won by %s! The defenders are routed, and their land and stores pass to the victor.
message.jaymoskingdoms.siege.defeat: The siege of %s is broken! The attackers withdraw.
message.jaymoskingdoms.land.transferred: The land of %s passes to %s by right of conquest.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.siege.muster.0: Brothers! The muster sounds. We march on %s at dawn!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.siege.muster.1: Sharpen your blades. The siege of %s begins now!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.siege.victory.0: The walls are breached! %s falls to %s!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.siege.victory.1: Victory! The seat of %s is ours. Their land, their stores, their people are ours.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.siege.defeat.0: Fall back! The siege of %s is broken.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.siege.defeat.1: We cannot take %s. Sound the retreat.
